name: Dragon HD
access: Azure Speech in Microsoft Foundry (Speech SDK, Speech CLI and REST; cloud only)

voice.input_audio: none: SSML or plain text, with optional bracket style markers and paralinguistic tags in the text [ms-ssml-voice] [ms-hd]
voice.output_audio: opus, mp3, pcm and truesilk at 8, 16, 24 and 48 kHz. HD voices run in real time only; batch synthesis is not offered [ms-hd]
voice.voices: custom cloning: 30+ fine-tuned voices, each with a fixed persona (the Omni page counts 30+ and the comparison table says 30); multi-talker voices exist; personal voice (gated) is a separate Azure Speech feature [ms-hd] [ms-ssml-voice]
languages: Multilingual: voice names carry the locale of the original persona (for example de-de, en-us, zh-cn), and the Omni voices detect and switch the spoken language from the text; HD Flash voices speak only zh-CN and en-US [ms-hd] [ms-tc-omni]
voice.turn_detection: none: a synthesis model. A multi-talker DragonHD voice takes turns inside an mstts:dialog element, one mstts:turn per speaker [ms-ssml-voice]
voice.interruption: Not a conversation model. The pages read describe no barge-in message for synthesis; the client stops playback (inferred) [ms-hd]
voice.latency: Microsoft's HD voice page lists latency below 300 ms for Azure Speech HD voices; it does not say how this is measured [ms-hd]
voice.session_limit: No per-request limit for HD voices is published in the pages read [ms-hd]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Per character, not per token. The Azure retail price API lists US$22.00 per 1M characters for Neural HD Text to Speech, effective 2026-03-01 [azure-retail]. Microsoft's pages do not say which HD model that meter covers. Artificial Analysis also shows US$22 for a model it calls Azure HD 2.5 [aa-hd25]. The Azure pricing page shows no figure in the text read.

unknown: benchmarks: no independent score and no maker figure for this model was found in the pages read
generation: Microsoft gives the model no generation number
released: the Learn pages give no release date for Dragon HD
pricing_usd_per_mtok: the unit differs (US$ per 1M characters), see notes
context_window: not applicable to a synthesis model, and no token limit is published

system_card: Microsoft publishes no model card for Dragon HD in the pages read

style: the Learn pages disagree on style control for Dragon HD; one section shows bracket styles and mstts:express-as for it, and the element table and the comparison table say express-as is not supported [ms-hd] [ms-ssml-voice]
Artificial Analysis speech arena: the site's Azure HD 2.5 model may be a Dragon HD version, but Microsoft's pages do not name it, so no score is attached here
